<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

struct Metrics {
    bool inside = false;
    int maxOutside = -1;
    int currentOutside = 0;
    int currentInside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;

    void processOutside(char c) {
        if (isAlpha(c)) {
            currentOutside++;
        }
        if (currentOutside > 0 && (c == '_' || c == '(')) {
            maxOutside = max(maxOutside, currentOutside);
            currentOutside = 0;
        }
    }

    void processInside(char c) {
        if (isAlpha(c)) {
            currentInside++;
        }
        if (c == '_' || c == ')') {
            if (currentInside > 0) {
                insideWords++;
                currentInside = 0;
            }
            if (c == ')') {
                inside = false;
            }
        }
    }

    void maybeEnterParenthesis(char c) {
        if (c == '(') {
            inside = true;
        }
    }

    void finish() {
        if (currentOutside > 0) {
            maxOutside = max(maxOutside, currentOutside);
        }
    }

    bool isAlpha(char a) {
        return (a >= 'A' && a <= 'Z') || (a >= 'a' && a <= 'z');
    }
};

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    Metrics m;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (m.inside) {
            m.processInside(c);
        } else {
            m.processOutside(c);
        }
        m.maybeEnterParenthesis(c);
    }
    m.finish();

    cout << (m.maxOutside == -1 ? 0 : m.maxOutside) << " ";
    cout << m.insideWords << endl;

    return 0;
}
